title: The shelf itself is nice once installed
text:
The shelf itself is nice once installed. The shelf itself is nice once installed, the problem we had was the installation.
1. I followed directions and put in the plastic screw anchors then attached the shelf and it was wobbly/not sturdy. We had to use some others that we had at the house and once we replaced the anchors, it was solid and did not wobble.
2. Then when we went to put the little bar on the front, the washers that are supposed to go on top and bottom of class were too small, the screws did not fit through.
These are 2 very large design flaws, luckily for us we have the necessary tools/replacement parts to make it work but someone else may not have those options or knowledge to do so.
